Hello and welcome!

I made this after seeing another crystal obelisk mod that was outdated, and wanted to make my own!
I had a ton of fun making these textures and can't wait to make more!!!
I'm very indecisive so I'll be tweaking the textures a ton in the next coming weeks, so here's a preemptive apology for that <3

The only override exception I've made thus far is for Gwen's buildings. If you'd like another, just ask!

Special thanks to ﻿Nuztalgia from the Stardew Valley Discord for being so supportive and patient in helping me figure out the complicated coding part of modding and for allowing me to spam her with progress pictures of my work!
